identity_text: a woman in her mid-twenties with dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair, hazel-green eyes, light natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, natural full lips, real human skin texture with visible pores
setting: a softly lit home makeup vanity with a round mirror light, warm white key light from the front, cream-colored wall, makeup brushes in a glass holder on the left, she wears a black satin robe
negative_prompt: extra fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, face morphing, different person, identity change, makeup appearing without tool contact, plastic skin, flicker, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cartoon, blurred details, static, worst quality

stages.name: Rostro inicial
stages.action: looks into the camera with a bare, natural face (no makeup), hair pulled back with a soft headband, begins to sing the first line softly

stages.name: Preparación de piel
stages.action: presses a small amount of serum onto her cheeks with her fingertips and then pats primer on her forehead and cheeks with her right hand, skin texture visible, while singing

stages.name: Base y contorno
stages.action: blends liquid foundation with a damp beauty sponge using small pressing motions, then draws contour under the cheekbones with a dense angled brush and blends it, while singing

stages.name: Sombras y ojos
stages.action: with one eye closed, sweeps dark midnight-blue eyeshadow onto the eyelid with a fluffy blending brush, building it up gradually in two passes, while humming the melody

stages.name: Delineado
stages.action: holds a black liquid eyeliner pen and draws a sharp winged line along the upper lash line in one steady stroke, elbow resting on the table, then sings again

stages.name: Labios
stages.action: outlines her lips with a deep plum lip liner and fills them with a lip brush, then presses her lips together and continues singing

stages.name: Detalles de caracterización
stages.action: places tiny silver crystals along her cheekbones with tweezers and paints thin silver filigree lines at the outer corner of the eyes with a fine detail brush, while singing

stages.name: Resultado final cinematográfico
stages.action: removes the headband, lets her hair fall, turns slowly to the camera with the complete makeup and sings the final line with confidence, cinematic lighting
